entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I'm still just as shocked as I was when[n]we first came here...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: The Navigator's returned to our devices...[n]A Palace is visible in our own reality...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Um, does this mean reality's broken[n]right now, or something?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Something to do with Dr. Maruki,[n]anyway?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hey, [fName]—how much do you[n]already know about this stuff?
I should tell them what I know so far...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: So Dr. Maruki...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: He altered our reality... to make[n]our dreams come true?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: This is all too much for me to handle[n]at once.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Apologies for the interruption—mind[n]if I interject?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: That's right! Akechi—!

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: There's no reason to be defensive.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Had I wished to kill you all, I would've[n]simply done so already.
He's helping... for now.
Akechi's not our enemy.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: So you're not here to fight us?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I've already put our feud behind me.[n]Not only that...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Since he and I both refuse to accept[n]reality as Maruki sees fit to make it,[n]we currently have the same goal.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: So what you're saying is, you're using[n]him.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: What about the rest of you?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Considering how you were all living[n]your ideal lives in that other reality[n]until you decided to come here...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Maruki seems to be telling the truth[n]about taking your happiness into[n]consideration.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: While his heart is distorted, he is quite[n]different from the adults whose hearts[n]you've changed so far.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Now that you know his intentions, I'm[n]most interested in learning whether[n]you still plan on fighting him or not.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: What do you mean?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I'm up against someone with the power[n]to distort reality as we know it. The more[n]allies on my side, the better.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: If we all share the same goal, shouldn't[n]we join forces and improve our odds?

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Nnh...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I'll be going now. Be sure to consider[n]my point.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hey... Hey!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Geez...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Yoshizawa! Are you all right?
Are you okay?
Can you stand?

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Oh, yes...

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: I'm sorry that I... caused you all so much[n]trouble...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: No no, you don't need to apologize!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We should probably go our separate ways[n]for now and discuss it at a better time.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Yeah. Tomorrow we can...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Oh yeah, third semester's startin' up[n]tomorrow, right?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I guess we're going back to school, huh?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: We still don't have any idea what we[n]want to do from here on out, though...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We've got time. Maruki said he'll wait[n]until [clr 2]February 3rd[clr 27] before...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Let's really think it over before making[n]our decision.
